<!-- pr-reviewer: c5880917cb2b4c3ac8d00ccc54e9555cddbe29ec -->
Read-only safety-floor review (Opus, diff only, not built) of head c5880917cb2b4c3ac8d00ccc54e9555cddbe29ec.

Verdict: no blockers

## What I checked

- The diff, the issue #2473, and the PR body.
- `assets/posts/tormach.cps` at the head: `indexFor` (691-760), `motionFor` (806-810), `turnMove` (870-912), `onRapid` / `onLinear` / `onCircular` (1045-1075), the probe and cycle callers (1168, 1229, 1350), `endPreamble` (562-580).
- `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs:408-541` (`dump`, the `tilted` state and the `abc` arms) and `crates/post/src/post/cnc.rs:194-198`.
- The move builders: `crates/cl/src/cl/path.rs:276-403`, `crates/cl/src/cl/path_approach.rs:68`, `crates/app/src/operation/fixture_route.rs:212`, `crates/app/src/project/entity.rs:497-519`.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs:705` (a post warning blocks the program).
- AGENTS.md: Prime Directive, Pull Request Law, Testing, Code shape, Clean-Room Protocol.

## The law

- A rapid or linear record with no A word, in a section whose `aSection` is not 0 modulo 360, now returns false from `indexFor` with a named refusal (`tormach.cps:717-722`). `onRapid` and `onLinear` return before any block. The move is not written.
- Arcs, canned cycles and probe moves with no A word were refused before. They are still refused. Only the text changes (see finding 1).
- The first move of a section: `aSection` is `null` there, so the new branch does not apply. The post indexes the table with `G53 G0 Z..` then `G0 A..`. That is a stated turn, not a silent one. A section after a tool change starts the same way, because `endPreamble` sets `aSection = null`.
- Legal programs that still post:
  - An upright operation: `a = 0`, `aSection = 0`, `d = 0`. The branch does not run.
  - A stated `A0`, then moves with no A: `turnMove` sets the held angle to the stated turn, then `d = 0`. The third test pins this.
  - Wrapped A at a multiple of 360: `d` is reduced modulo 360 before the compare (`:714-716`), so `aSection = 360` and `a = 0` give `d = 0`.
  - Float compare: the compare is `Math.abs(d) <= A_EPS` (1e-6 degrees) after the modulo, never an exact compare against 0.
- I found no path that still writes a silent A0 turn inside an operation.

## The worker's "guard" claim

- The claim is consistent with the source. `dump` writes `abc = None` only when the CL move states no axis. It writes explicit zeros on the first return to the Z column after a lean (`mod.rs:506-520`).
- The `Toolpath` builder attaches the modal axis to each move (`path.rs:302`, `:338`, `:391`, `:400`; `path_approach.rs:68`). The fixture route copies the axis of its neighbour (`fixture_route.rs:212`).
- A loaded `.cl` file keeps its own axis words verbatim (`entity.rs:519`). An external `.cnc` file owns its letters. Such files can reach the new branch. The refusal is the correct result for them.

## The tests

- `crates/post/tests/tormach_no_a_word.rs`: on the main script, the rapid and linear cases post a turn (or a different refusal), so the assert on the new text fails. The two refusal tests pin the law. The third test guards against an over-refusal. It also passes on main, which is correct for its purpose.
- The Gate map line is present. It names `assets/posts/tormach.cps` and `camcraft_post::post::engine` / `::machine`. That is the correct crate.
- The test imports only `camcraft_post` and `serde_json`. `camcraft-post` is the lowest crate that provides them.
- The file has a provenance line and has 131 lines.

## AGENTS.md

- The body has what changed, readings, pinning tests, a gate list, not exercised, a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2473`.
- `docs/decisions/2473-tormach-a-without-word.md` follows the README format: heading, decided, why, dropped, cost to change.
- No snapshot PNG. No `PROCESS_VERSION` edit. The title is a conventional `fix(post):` subject.
- I found no copied third-party text.
- The `.cps` change has no throw path: `ax` is not null in that branch (checked at `:695`), and `what || "move"` covers the empty name.

## Findings

1. Not a blocker. `tormach.cps:720-722`: an arc, a canned cycle or a probe move with no A word in an indexed section now gets the text "states no A angle" and not "turns A - the post writes a turning A on straight G0 / G1 moves only". The move is still refused. No test asserts the old text (I searched `crates/`).
2. Not a blocker, not new. `tormach.cps:662-665` (`aRefuse`): the post names only the first 4th-axis refusal of a program. Later refused moves are dropped without a second message. The app blocks a program with any warning (`crates/app/src/posting.rs:705`), so no program is written.
3. Not a blocker. Issue #2473 "Done when" asks for a recorded `.cl` file that shows if the stream can emit such a record. The PR gives a source reading in its place. I agree with the reading, but the first item of "Done when" is not met by a recording.
4. Not a blocker. Binaries that load `tormach.cps` and that the body does not list: the `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui` lib tests, and the `camcraft-app` test binaries `between_setups`, `fixture_plate`, `rigid_tapping`, `post_cycle_feed_spindle`, `probe_op`, `probe_no_coolant`, `probe_spindle_range`, `tormach_machines`, `tormach_routers`, `recorded_post_streams`, `program_info`, `program_comments`, `program_entry`, `control_comp`, `coolant_air`, `wear_comp`, `machine_default_holder`, `units_migrate`, and the lathe and plasma suites. I read their streams: they are upright. The new branch needs a held A that is not 0, so none of them looks at risk.

## Follow-ups (not blockers)

- `dump` (`mod.rs:520`) reads a move with no axis as "keep the modal pose". The post reads the first such record of a section as A0 and indexes to it. That is a stated turn with a Z lift, so it is not a silent turn. But the two readings differ. A note on #2473 or a small P7 issue can record it.

I did not build or run tests.

The PR is ready and merges now, on the maintainer's order of 2026-11-18.

- Head: `c5880917cb2b4c3ac8d00ccc54e9555cddbe29ec`. No push came after the review.
- Review that this merge relies on: the read-only safety-floor review (Opus, diff only, not built) in comment 6975287014, verdict "no blockers". The reviewer did not write the change.
- Gate: the author ran the binaries that load `tormach.cps`, one step for each binary. The one red step is the known failure of `main`, #2483.
- Class: not a refresh. The branch merges with `main` with no conflict.
